name: kingmaker
roninProvenance: Recovered source baseline; see RECOVERY.md and release build metadata.
description: Kingmaker: a Mac agent with no window. Your Mac's own apps are the screen, voice drives it, its engine governs every step, the Hands of Horus do the clicking.

scripts.test:armor: node scripture-armor/test/run-tests.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v2-scan.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v2-phase4.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v2-cell.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v2-airlock.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v2-estate.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-v4-pq.mjs && node scripture-armor/test/run-tests-gemini-fix.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:os && npm run test:armor && npm run typecheck
scripts.proof:owner-voice: node --experimental-sqlite ${KINGMAKER_ENGINE_SRC:?set KINGMAKER_ENGINE_SRC to the engine source checkout}/server/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs test/owner-voice.proof.mjs
scripts.proof:owner-keys: node --experimental-sqlite ${KINGMAKER_ENGINE_SRC:?set KINGMAKER_ENGINE_SRC to the engine source checkout}/server/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs test/owner-keys.proof.mjs
